categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies outbound message queuing and bounds checks in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents crashes and buffer overruns by validating outbound message sizes in CConnman. Commit 4b10305dee notes that without bounds checks on message types, 'V1 aborts on a longer type, while V2 can overwrite the first payload byte or write past its encoding buffer.' Hardening outbound serialization against oversized internal or RPC-generated payloads fixes a concrete transport failure mode.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Lacks the RPC label and the 4-line adjustment in src/rpc/net.cpp is a direct consequence of the P2P outbound message bounds enforcement.
categories.rationale: The change to sendmsgtopeer is minor input validation following the net-layer message bounds rather than a substantive change to RPC infrastructure or public interfaces.
